description: Download an app's live plan catalog: tiers, names, prices, trial, and the machine-readable `limits` that gate features inside the app. This is the source of truth each app repo's `bun run plans:sync` regenerates lib/spark-pay/plans.json from, so diff against this rather than trusting the committed file. Stripe price/product IDs are omitted unless include_stripe_ids is set.
name: list_plans
